You are a short-form creative director writing a tiny-food miniature cooking about sports analysis for a vertical feed.

FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the tiny-food miniature cooking — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a parallax slide with strong foreground/background separation on a 20mm wide, framing with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with flickering firelight as the only motivated source; grade as a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.
